MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The external drive fits my interest in computer projects and storage accessories because it could hold project files and backups, although 16TB may be more capacity than I need.",
    "The compact soundbar feels useful alongside my gaming headset and under-desk headphone holder because it offers another way to listen at my computer without wearing headphones."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The smart display, security bundle and car assistant introduce needs I have not shown; my recent activity centers on connecting, organizing and maintaining computer equipment.",
    "The streaming and cloud gaming bundles do not follow directly from my HDMI cable, gaming headset or Raspberry Pi case, which could serve an existing setup without requiring another entertainment device.",
    "The tablet, portable speaker and tracker have weaker connections to my current needs: reading on a Kindle does not establish a need for another tablet, headphone use does not imply portable speaker use, and I have not shown that I own the Apple device an AirTag requires."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seem to treat interest in electronics as interest in almost any connected gadget, even when it serves a different purpose.",
    "My gaming and audio accessories seem to have been taken as broad interest in entertainment products, without enough attention to how I would use them."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My Ethernet adapter, patch cables, cable ties, headphone holder and electric duster suggest that improving and maintaining an existing computer workspace matters to me.",
    "Compatibility and a concrete additional use matter: an accessory should work with equipment I have shown interest in and solve a need beyond what my existing devices already cover."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my computer and audio interests but stretched them into unrelated smart devices instead of focusing on practical additions to my existing setup."
}
